full.description: This is a photomicrograph of breast tissue. The image displays a benign lesion characterized by intraductal papillomatosis, showing branching fibrovascular papillae lined by epithelial and myoepithelial cells. The overall architectural pattern is typical of a benign intraductal papilloma of the breast.

blind.description: This is a micrograph of prostate tissue. It shows well-differentiated adenocarcinoma characterized by perineural invasion. The malignant glands infiltrate the tissue surrounding a nerve. The findings are indicative of prostate adenocarcinoma.

random.description: This is a photomicrograph of a breast tissue biopsy stained with H&E, shown at moderate magnification. The image displays a benign proliferative lesion characterized by ductal hyperplasia and lobular architecture. The ducts show branching epithelial proliferation within a fibromyxoid stroma. These histological features are characteristic of fibrocystic changes or usual ductal hyperplasia of the breast.
